scope: Independent comparison of three canonical 400x946 isolated Queue panel states. Four assessed categories cover 85% of the shared rubric; combined state/responsive 15% is null/excluded. Not an overall VLC/UI/release score.
review_method: Visual inspection with tools.view_image of the original PNG exports and current production QML captures, followed by side-by-side and cyan/magenta overlay inspection.
Original PNGs composited on black using Pillow alpha_composite for color comparison; original bytes preserved separately. Render snapshots copied byte-for-byte.

Geometry measured from foreground pixels above luminance30 in predefined regions; bounding boxes are exclusive-right/bottom. SVG text and rectangle metadata read for reference only; vector paths not inspected, edited or redrawn.

Scores independently assigned from the observed images and measured differences; no implementer or previous reviewer score was read or used. Pixel error is corroborating evidence, not a substituted visual score. Whole-image MAE is dominated by the empty body, so top300 and per-element metrics are also provided.

limitations: The original isolated PNGs show no informative scene behind the translucent surface; black-matted comparison cannot establish native transparency, color blending or blur over video.
The 50px Figma background blur is absent from the Qt panel.
Full VLC/native Windows release rendering, real playlist/bookmark/chapter model integration and full application visual quality are not evaluated by this report.
Hover, selected, playback-current, disabled, keyboard-focus, overflow, narrow/wide and high-DPI responsive fidelity are unassessed.
Only the supplied canonical 400x946 scenes are scored; no overall UI score is issued.
Measurements include renderer-specific antialiasing and glyph bearing, so a 1px ink-bound difference does not necessarily indicate an anchor/layout error.
